messages:
sanjay: Heads up — found a nasty HF->Redwood generation_config conversion edgecase while onboarding a quantized Llama-variant. quality dropped after mapping, looks like rep_penalty got coerced to an integer path.

maria: Ugh, any repro snippet?

sanjay: Repro: transformer saved generation_config.json had floats and special flags. our converter did something like `int(float(x))` in one branch. e.g. the file: ```json
{"temperature":0.7,"top_p":0.92,"top_k":-1,"repetition_penalty":1.15,"do_sample":true}``` after conversion we ended up with `"repetition_penalty":1` and `"top_k":0` in the runtime config.

devon: top_k -1 -> disabled is common in HF. mapping to 0 is wrong (0 means keep top0?). we should map negative to null/None so runtime disables top-k.

lisa: Also double-check `do_sample` + `temperature=0.0` combos. HF sometimes uses `temperature=0` as a signal for deterministic sampling; we currently clamp 0->0.0001 which changed behavior on a few prompts.

maria: This explains why the quantized runs hallucinated more — rep_penalty rounding from 1.15->1 changed repetition handling. can you share quick eval numbers?

sanjay: quick eval (small suite): before conversion: bleu/EM/hallucination rates: `BLEU=21.3, EM=58.2, halluc=3.1%`. after bad conversion: `BLEU=18.9, EM=54.7, halluc=10.2%`. eval-bot flagged regression on 6/12 tests.

eval-bot: automated-eval: regression detected on commit abc123 - delta_hallucination +7.1% (p<0.01). see /internal/evals/1802509876 for details. :warning:

lisa: Oof. Another gotcha: HF `top_p` sometimes stored as `0` meaning no nucleus sampling, but other codepaths expect `0` to be valid float. treat `top_p==0` and `top_k<=0` as "disabled" and remove those keys from the runtime config.

devon: Agree. Also watch for `repetition_penalty` types — some model hubs export strings: `"repetition_penalty": "1.1"`. our parser should coerce to float and validate range (0.5..2.0) and keep precision (2 dec places).

maria: Could be a problem with chat templates adding BOS/EOS tokens and changing effective prompt lengths; combine with caching changes + different gen params and quantization = amplified reg. worth adding targeted unit tests.

sanjay: Proposal: 1) normalize conversion: coerce numeric strings -> float, keep precision, map negative top_k -> null, remove disabled keys (top_k/top_p) instead of 0, treat temperature==0 as exact zero (deterministic) not epsilon. 2) add golden regression tests for quantized bundles using a small eval set. 3) patch and rollout canary to Dedicated.

lisa: +1. Also add a warning when config has conflicting deterministic flags (do_sample=false but temp>0).

devon: I'll open a PR for the converter with the normalization and tests. Ping me if you want to pair on the eval harness.

maria: Thanks — can we also scan recent model onboarding PRs for accidental overrides? could be more affected ones.

sanjay: I'll run a quick grep across `models/*/generation_config.json` and post a short list here in 30m. :mag_right:

eval-bot: scheduled-scan: found 3 model packs with `repetition_penalty` as string and 2 with `top_k` set to -1 (expected) but 1 with `top_k` set to 0 (suspicious). report: /internal/convert-scans/1802509876.json

maria: Perfect. Let's treat this as P0 for the onboarding queue until PR lands. :thumbsup:

sanjay: Will follow up with PR link + quick canary plan. thanks everyone.
